subject: Bar within bar chart, including legend

messages.author: 28f2fe71e9b7afcf
messages.subject: Bar within bar chart, including legend
parts:
I tried to post yesterday but either I did something wrong or it didn't go through.

So I'm trying to create a bar chart within a bar chart, with the second bar slightly less wide so you can see both at once.  The problem is that I can't seem to create one legend for both bars.  Here's the code I'm using:

library(ggplot2)
sample_data <- data.frame(matrix(data=c('var1','var2','var3',15,20,25,5,8,10),nrow=3,ncol=3))

    X1 X2 X3
1 var1 15  5
2 var2 20  8
3 var3 25 10

ggplot(data=sample_data) + geom_bar(aes(x=X1,y=as.numeric(as.character(X2))),fill='orange') + geom_bar(aes(x=X1,y=as.numeric(as.character(X3))),fill='red',width=.5)

Notice the chart looks nice, but there's no legend.

I know that I could reshape the data so I can use a variable for fill, but then I can't seem to edit the widths:

sample_data_melt <- melt(sample_data,id.var='X1')

    X1 variable value
1 var1       X2    15
2 var2       X2    20
3 var3       X2    25
4 var1       X3     5
5 var2       X3     8
6 var3       X3    10

ggplot(data=sample_data_melt) + geom_bar(aes(x=X1,y=as.numeric(as.character(value)),fill=variable),position='identity',stat='identity')

Here I think the blue bar is in front of the pink bar, but it has the same width so you can't tell.  And notice there is a legend that works.  I also seem to have trouble here with the colors.  As another point, I'm aware that I probably shouldn't be using "as.numeric(as.character(value))" and I have to because of the weird way I made the data.  Any comment on that would be useful too.

Thanks for your help!
